game_concept: A action puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Rune Circle, a circle of glowing runes: the ruin warden must handle echo phantoms while practicing lists. Core idea – Stack Of Plates: Push and pop from the end of a list to handle last-in, first-out stacks.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Rune Circle: a circle of glowing runes
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
player_objective: Declare double: declare resource as double, apply resource * 4.5, and print each result with %.1f. Dataset 5 starts with [-3, 0, 13, 16]. Match every stream. Use a full main function and a return statement.
controls: Edit the C program. Run tests all streams; Step shows declarations, assignments and output. readInput() is a LogiCade game-port helper declared in logicade.h. This safe practice runtime supports a documented C subset.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Stack Of Plates' (Week 7 slot 5), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Rune Circle'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Basic Parts of C and Variable Declarations
